array_pers.source:
on init
set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 64, -1, -1)
declare $cv
declare $cb
declare $s
make_persistent($s)
  $cv := $s
  $cb := 0
  while ($cb < 8)
    if ((sh_right($cv, $cb) mod 2) # 0)
      set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 32 + $cb, -1, -1)
    end if
    inc($cb)
  end while
read_persistent_var($s)
declare %a[3]
make_persistent(%a)
  $cv := %a[1]
  $cb := 0
  while ($cb < 8)
    if ((sh_right($cv, $cb) mod 2) # 0)
      set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 0 + $cb, -1, -1)
    end if
    inc($cb)
  end while
if ($s = 0)
  %a[1] := 5
  $s := 1
end if
  $cv := %a[1]
  $cb := 0
  while ($cb < 8)
    if ((sh_right($cv, $cb) mod 2) # 0)
      set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 16 + $cb, -1, -1)
    end if
    inc($cb)
  end while
set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 65, -1, -1)
end on
on persistence_changed
set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 66, -1, -1)
  $cv := %a[1]
  $cb := 0
  while ($cb < 8)
    if ((sh_right($cv, $cb) mod 2) # 0)
      set_engine_par($ENGINE_PAR_VOLUME, 1000, 24 + $cb, -1, -1)
    end if
    inc($cb)
  end while
end on
